## PROBLEM
Specialists runtime commit f263a228 and README commit 49c6501e are independently validated but neither is in origin/master and neither has a PR. The README branch is separate from the runtime branch.

## SUCCESS
A reviewed Specialists integration PR combines the accepted runtime/dist/config stack and README-only documentation onto current origin/master, resolves lineage safely, and lands without changing established runtime contracts.

## SCOPE
Specialists f263a228 lineage, README 49c6501e content, release-facing documentation consistency required for main, integration tests, PR, CI, and merge.

## NON_GOALS
No npm publication. Do not silently waive unitAI-641h0 or unitAI-x64ys. Do not claim release attestation before exact merged-artifact validation.

## CONSTRAINTS
Use an isolated branch/worktree from current origin/master. Preserve accepted trust semantics and built dist. Reconcile README by content if commit ancestry differs. Never edit local master directly.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Full suite, focused trust, integration, build, lint, package smoke, and diff checks pass.
- [ ] README claims match the integrated head.
- [ ] Reviewer, seconder, and security accept exact PR head.
- [ ] PR merges to origin/master.

## LIBRARIES
N/A — integration of existing code/documentation only.

## OUTPUT
PR URL, merged commit, changed files, exact gates, and residual blockers.
